value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task 'Open the door and pick up the box in the other room' requires both events, but the candidate only has Existence(door_open). Nothing requires target_picked_up, so the episode could be considered finished merely by opening the door while the mission's actual objective (picking up the box) is unenforced. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); the door_open clause can remain as is (no Precedence is needed, since the task states no order between them).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task commands two events — opening the door and picking up the target box — without stating an order between them ('...and pick up...'). The hard Existence(door_open) and hard Existence(target_picked_up) clauses each make one commanded event happen, match the task sentences, and no order clause is stated, so none is required.
